name: Guerrero White Corn Tortillas (Skillet-Warmed)
whyItWorks: Made from finely ground nixtamalized corn masa treated with lime (calcium hydroxide), which dissolves the outer fibrous corn husk. Naturally gluten-free, low in fat, and soft when heated.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm on a dry cast-iron skillet for 30 seconds per side until pliable and steaming. Never eat cold or stiff.
